title: Data on Employee Burnout by Sector
what_it_is: Data on Employee Burnout by Sector

sections.label: iWorkHealth stress assessment tool
sections.summary: MOM, WSH Council and partners developed iWorkHealth, a free online psycho-social assessment tool; 2024 data showed one in three employees experienced work-related stress or burnout.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Notwithstanding this, to encourage employers to monitor the state of their workforce's well-being and address key work stressors, MOM and the Workplace Safety and Health (WSH) Council, in collaboration with the Institute of Mental Health, Changi General Hospital and the Health Promotion Board, have developed and made available iWorkHealth, a free online psycho-social assessment tool.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Based on anonymised and aggregated data of more than 15,000 employees from employers that took up iWorkHealth in 2024, one in three employees experienced work-related stress or burnout.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The proportion has remained relatively stable since iWorkHealth was introduced in 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Given that participation in iWorkHealth is voluntary, the sample may not be fully reflective of the overall workforce or at the industry level.

sections.label: Tripartite Advisory on mental health
sections.summary: MOM implemented measures including the Tripartite Advisory on Mental Health and Well-being at Workplaces, offering employers guidance and support measures such as Employee Assistance Programme providers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In addition to iWorkHealth, MOM has implemented a range of measures to promote mental well-being at the workplace.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: These include the Tripartite Advisory on Mental Health and Well-being at Workplaces, which offers practical guidance to employers and highlights available support measures, including a list of Employee Assistance Programme service providers and their areas of specialisation.

sections.label: Career Health SG initiative
sections.summary: Career Health SG was introduced under SkillsFuture to empower Singaporeans to develop resilient and fulfilling careers through training, on-the-job learning and intentional career moves.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Career Health SG initiative has been introduced under the SkillsFuture movement, to empower Singaporeans to develop resilient and fulfilling careers and achieve their aspirations through training, on-the-job learning and intentional career moves.

sections.label: Workplace mental well-being initiatives
sections.summary: The Workbook on Workplace Mental Well-being supplements the Tripartite Advisory with actionable guidance and templates, while the Total Workplace Safety and Health Programme provides free mental well-being workshops.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: One initiative will be the Workbook on Workplace Mental Well-being, which supplements the Tripartite Advisory by providing additional and actionable guidance for employers, such as the ready-to-use templates for creating safe spaces for conversations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: Another example is the Total Workplace Safety and Health Programme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: This particular programme provides the organisations free access to mental well-being workshops.
